title: Stabilize observability fanout after event gap recovery (customer escalations)
creator: Aisha Thompson
description: Multiple customers reported missing time-series and truncated traces following a cross-region control-plane failover. Investigation shows an event fanout mismatch between the telemetry ingesters and the dashboard aggregation tier, resulting in opaque gaps (partial metric shards) and broken live-panel renderings. This ticket scopes the immediate repair, stabilization changes to fanout/ingest coordination, and communication/remediation runbook for affected customers.
reproduction_steps: Simulate control-plane failover in staging by toggling region-primary flag and shepherding ingestion through the secondary region
Load replay of high-cardinality tenant traffic for 30 minutes using telemetry-replay-v2 (link in artifacts)
Observe metric shard registration events and verify fanout acknowledgements across ingestion replicas
Trigger a dashboard live-panel refresh and inspect metric tiles for empty or partially-populated series
mitigation_history: 2026-03-02: Emergency hotpatch applied to resume probe-level re-ingest for critical SLO metrics (partial success)
2026-03-04: Circuit-breaker introduced on the aggregation service to prevent tombstoning of in-flight metric keys
2026-03-07: Customer-facing remediation emails sent with timeframe and temporary query workarounds
2026-03-10: Canary of rehydration job ran for 5 tenants; validated by QA for low-cardinality metrics only
root_cause_summary: A timing window during cross-region failover allowed ingestion fanout metadata updates to be applied out-of-order. The aggregation layer (live-panel router) accepted new shard manifests before all KV-index acknowledgements arrived, so queries for recently-writable series returned empty or partial datasets. Additionally, trace-span stitching logic did not fallback to secondary indices for late-arriving spans, producing truncated traces.
proposed_fix: Add two-phase fanout commit: metadata publish + ack quorum before aggregation manifest version increment
Enhance aggregation layer to fallback to previous manifest version for up to 2 minutes while rehydration completes
Extend trace-span reconciler to consult late-arrival index and perform incremental stitch within 120s window
Introduce a metric 'shard-health' probe surfaced in Console for ops and customers
acceptance_criteria: No missing live-panel tiles for synthetic workload replay for 60 minutes after failover in staging
Shards show ack_quorum >= 2 before manifest version increments during simulated failover
Incremental trace stitch succeeds for >99% of synthetic late-arrival spans within 120s
Customer remediation emails include a post-mortem draft and playbook link
rollout_plan: 1) Merge PR to feature branch and run full telemetry-replay smoke-suite
2) Deploy aggregation fallback and two-phase commit to staging region-only (48h soak)
3) Run cross-region failover test with telemetry-replay for multi-tenant pattern and validate metrics and traces
4) Gradual rollout to prod: 10% of traffic -> 50% -> 100% with manual gate at each step
5) Enable Console 'shard-health' probe and publish update to customers once 100% rollout completes
